name: laqeeto-native
description: Laqeeto (لقيته) — Stolen Phone Registry: native wrappers (Capacitor Android/iOS, Electron Windows/macOS) around the web app at the repo root
author: Youssef <youssef@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.dist:win: npm run build:www && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:www && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:www && electron-builder --linux dir --publish never
